title: Oracle host machine
statement: Given a finite Boolean oracle machine $M$ with $m$ ordinary work tapes and a finite Boolean Turing machine $C$ with $c$ work tapes, where $C$ has at least one work tape, and chosen entry and exit states $e$ and $x$ of $C$, define a finite Boolean Turing machine with $(m+2)+(c+1)+1$ work tapes. Its state set is the disjointly tagged union of the phase-specific state sets; its initial state is the dispatch phase's boot state; and its transition behavior is given by the phase host machine built from the oracle phase machines, with redirections determined by $M$, $C$, and exit state $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ has at least one work tape
caveat: The phase-host construction and the underlying phase-machine definitions are not included, so the transition behavior is only specified by their roles in the given construction.
